items.title: Vince Giordano interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 11, 2007
items.q: Like Ty Cobb, hit ‘em where they ain’t.

ctx.x: Like Ty Cobb, hit ‘em where they ain’t. You know, play the instruments that you can get called to do.
Well I’m curious as to what — in your childhood or teen years or something — turned you on to the music from the twenties and thirties?
